preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM clinlims.notebook_page np JOIN clinlims.notebook n ON n.id = np.notebook_id WHERE (n.workflow_type = 'biorepository' OR n.title LIKE 'Biorepository%') AND ( np.instructions LIKE '%Room > Device%' OR np.content LIKE '%Storage Room%' )

changeSet.comment: Relabel biorepository notebook page instructions/content from Room to Zone
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.notebook_page np SET instructions = REPLACE( REPLACE(np.instructions, 'Room > Device', 'Zone > Device'), 'storage hierarchy: Room', 'storage hierarchy: Zone' ), content = REPLACE(np.content, '"label": "Storage Room"', '"label": "Storage Zone"') FROM clinlims.notebook n WHERE n.id = np.notebook_id AND (n.workflow_type = 'biorepository' OR n.title LIKE 'Biorepository%') AND ( np.instructions LIKE '%Room > Device%' OR np.content LIKE '%Storage Room%' );
